purpose: The list of sources a generative AI response drew on (Cloudscape's sources expandable section, AI Elements Sources): a disclosure titled `3 sources` that opens an ordered list — number, linked title, one-line description. Item `n` carries the id `<anchor>-source-<n>`, the target of the `[n]` citations `StreamingResponse` renders; following a citation opens the list and brings the item into view.
useWhen: A response is grounded in documents, pages or records the reader may want to open or verify.
avoidWhen: Related links that the response did not use → `help-panel` links or a plain list.
A single source → cite it inline with a link; a list of one is noise.
related: citation` — the inline `[n]` that points here.
streaming-response` — renders the citations; share the `anchor`.
chat-message` — sources sit inside the assistant message, under the response.
bestPractices: Order items as the response first cites them, so `[1]` is item 1.
Use the page title, not the URL, as the title; add the site or section as the description.
Keep the list collapsed by default; the inline citations are the primary path.
